facts.text: The hotel is in Dongfengyun Art Village, a hamlet of vineyards, lavender fields and post-modern architecture.
facts.excerpt: This hotel is situated in Dongfengyun Art Village, a quaint hamlet comprised of vineyards, lavender fields, and post-modern architecture.

facts.text: The hotel's architecture is artistic and all of its buildings are made of red brick.
facts.excerpt: Unique artistic architecture, with all buildings made of red bricks.

facts.text: The hotel won the Special Prize Exterior of the Prix Versailles for its depiction of the Magic Castle in red brick.
facts.excerpt: Winner of the Special Prize Exterior of Prix Versailles with its depiction of the Magic Castle in red brick.

facts.text: Guests can experience a local welcome ceremony, a wine-opening ritual and pottery-making sessions.
facts.excerpt: Experience the local welcome ceremony , a wine-opening ritual and pottery-making sessions.

facts.text: The hotel is located in a 4A tourist attraction.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is located in 4A tourist attraction.

facts.text: The outdoor pool is surrounded by a 360-degree view of the surrounding scenery.
facts.excerpt: outdoor pool is surrounded by a 360° view of the surrounding scenery.

facts.text: The fitness center has Life Fitness equipment plus a dry sauna and steam room.
facts.excerpt: The 142 m² fitness center has Life Fitness equipment as well as a dry sauna and steam room for you to relax in.

facts.text: Huijing Chinese Restaurant's Cantonese chef serves authentic Cantonese dishes and modern Yunnan cuisine, with wine pairings for each dish.
facts.excerpt: Our Cantonese chef specializes in authentic Cantonese dishes and modern Yunnan cuisine, with wine pairings to go with each dish.

facts.text: Shake Lobby Lounge serves afternoon tea sets with organic Chinese tea or coffee, plus cocktails, wine and whiskeys.
facts.excerpt: Shake lobby lounge offers exquisite afternoon tea sets plus organic Chinese tea or coffee, afternoon tea, cocktails, wine and whiskeys.

facts.text: Some Deluxe Rooms come with a private balcony and a garden pool.
facts.excerpt: DELUXE ROOM, One King-size Bed, Private Balcony, and Garden Pool

facts.text: The Amber Spiral suite has two units, sleeping up to six, with lake or mountain views.
facts.excerpt: THE AMBER SPIRAL, 2 Units, 1 King Size Bed, 2 Single Size Beds, Lake or Mountain View.

facts.text: The Ruby Wheel suite has a living room, lake view and private balcony.
facts.excerpt: THE RUBY WHEEL, 1 King Size Bed, 1 Living Room, Lake View, Private Balcony

facts.text: Kunming Changshui International Airport is about 150 km from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Kunming Changshui International Airport is about 150 km from the hotel.

facts.text: By high-speed train it is a 40-minute ride from Kunming South Railway Station to Mile Station, then a 10-minute taxi to the hotel.
facts.excerpt: By high‑speed train: 40‑min ride from Kunming South Railway Station to Mile Station, then a 10‑min taxi to the hotel.

facts.text: The hotel offers wedding planning with indoor and outdoor venues.
facts.excerpt: diverse and flexible indoor/outdoor venues to provide all the help you need to host an unforgettable wedding.

facts.text: The surroundings serve as a natural oxygen bar.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy the pleasant surroundings which serve as a natural oxygen bar.

facts.text: The outdoor pool is the biggest in the area.
facts.excerpt: Our outdoor swimming pool of 1300sqm is the biggest in the area.

facts.text: The ALL Together Superior Room sleeps up to four.
